Theorem
[Initial conditions for d'Alembert's solution]

↗ def:dalembert-formula

\group Wave Equation

Under the preceding hypotheses, \[ u(x,0)=g(x), \qquad u_t(x,0)=h(x). \]
Proof

\sketch Substitute $t=0$ for the displacement. Differentiating the formula gives

\[ u_t=\frac12[g'(x+t)-g'(x-t)] +\frac12[h(x+t)+h(x-t)], \]

which equals $h(x)$ at $t=0$.

□
